text:
Google citations work like references.

Google checks your name, address and phone number across directories on the web. All matching? It moves on.

One listing with your old number, another with your old business name, and Google starts doubting which one is you.

Fix the old ones first.

Running Google Ads with no conversion tracking?

Then Google can't see which clicks turned into calls or enquiries. It just guesses.

A landscaper in Mandurah paying for every click deserves to know which ones rang.

Get tracking sorted before you touch a single keyword.

One job this week.

Search what you do plus your town, like a customer. "electrician Mount Barker". "dentist Ipswich".

On the map? Check your number and hours.
Missing? Claim your free Google Business Profile.

Website second.
https://gimsresults.com.au/post/do-i-need-a-google-business-profile
